purpose: Reproduce unsafe top-k indexing with overlapping synthetic voices and one requested cluster. This is native safety evidence, not speech accuracy evidence.

production_android_crash.analysis: The crash instruction is an inlined partial_sort comparator in TopkIndex. Tombstone x19=2 is the requested top-k, while x22=x25+4 gives a one-element index vector. A garbage out-of-range index is read past its end. JNI process+136 is the virtual Process call, before result marshaling.

old_host_run.meaning: native access violation; no result produced

android_regression_on_fixed_dependency: NOT RUN: the physical device was disconnected during investigation
